title: Finite extensions of algebraically closed fields
statement: Let $\Omega$ be an algebraically closed field [def-weil-algebraic-closure] (every nonconstant polynomial in $\Omega[X]$ has a root in $\Omega$), and let $K$ be a field together with a ring homomorphism $\iota:\Omega\to K$, making $K$ a field extension of $\Omega$ [def-pc-field-extension], such that the extension is finite, i.e. $K$ is finite-dimensional as an $\Omega$-vector space via $\iota$ [def-pc-field-tower]. Then $\iota$ is bijective, i.e. $K=\Omega$ (identifying $\Omega$ with $\iota(\Omega)$).
